summary: Doctor profile photo upload + PUT /api/doctor/profile fully verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (onboard with avatar_base64 → data URI avatar_url; PUT /doctor/profile bio+avatar happy path + persistence via GET /doctor/me; data URI prefix preserved; patient 403 'Doctors only'; empty body 400 'No fields to update'; >4MB avatar 422; unauth 401; public /api/doctors regression still projects safe fields). Frontend (Playwright, 390×844): doctor drtest@vaidhyaji login → Profile tab shows 'Edit profile & photo' button (testID profile-edit-doctor) → tap routes to /doctor/edit-profile → verified 'CLINIC PROFILE' eyebrow, 'Edit profile' title, Profile photo section (testIDs edit-photo + edit-photo-btn), specialty/qualification/experience/fee/languages/clinic fields, Save button (testID edit-save). Photo picker tap does not crash. Fresh patient login: profile-edit-doctor NOT rendered, patient's profile-edit (Edit health profile) still present (regression pass). Onboarding source code confirms Step 4/4 renders 'Profile photo' with testIDs do-photo + do-photo-btn.

minor.issue: Review request expected 404 'Complete onboarding first' when a fresh doctor account (registered but never onboarded) hits the endpoint, but /api/auth/register already inserts a stub doctor doc for role=doctor (server.py:339-354), so matched_count is never 0 and the endpoint returns 200. The 404 branch is effectively unreachable in the current registration flow. Consider gating on the presence of onboarded_at instead of matched_count if the business rule is to require onboarding first.

action_items: Optional: If business intent is truly 'block profile edits until onboarding complete', change /doctor/profile guard to check for onboarded_at (server.py ~2326) rather than matched_count, since register() pre-creates the doctor stub.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/doctor/profile: matched_count==0 check is dead code because /api/auth/register inserts a doctor doc for role=doctor at signup (server.py:339-354). Behavior mismatch with review request but not a functional regression for the reported bug (photo upload works).
Onboarding step 3 language-chip tap flakiness in Playwright headless was noted in iteration 22 and is not affected by this change; unrelated to bug fix.
